title: vineC's Cartoony Shaders
description: vineC's Cartoony Shaders gives Minecraft a clean, cartoon-inspired look by adding distinct outlines to the game world. It keeps the core feel of Minecraft intact but uses outlines and adjusted lighting to make every block, mob, and item pop.
